name: locale command
info: changes the language of the bot's responses
usage: locale set <locale> [url] | list | delete <locale> | view <locale> | reload

examples.bot: ⚙️ | This command is always in English by default. Usage: locale set <locale> [url] | list | delete <locale> | view <locale> | reload
🌐 | Available Locales (default: EN_US): EN_US (en, english, en-US); RU_RU (ru, russian, ru-RU);
